title: The Row of Ancestors

steps.prompt: 6 figures stand in a row of numbered chairs, numbered 1 to 6 from the left: the Baron, the Butler, the Cook, the Doctor, the Duke, the Heir. Use the clues, then answer: who stands in chair number 4? (Just the title, like Baron.)
clues: Exactly 3 chairs separate the Duke from the Baron.
The Duke is at one of the two ends of the row.
The Heir is directly next to the Baron.
The Cook is at one of the two ends of the row.
The Cook is somewhere to the left of the Baron.
The Butler is in an even-numbered chair.

reveal_text: A single key sinks down on its own. Under it a number is engraved: 5.
